briefDescription: A deep dive into your chart revealing your core themes, gifts, patterns and what the current stars are saying about where you are right now.

howItWorks: You fill in the form below with your date, time and place of birth, then pay.
I begin your reading within the next two days and send you a short note when I do.
Within seven days you receive a voice note and a PDF, sent to the email you gave me.
